authenticity_review: The image exhibits high photorealism with convincing fur textures and lighting. However, structural artifacts exist: the base of the giraffe's neck blends unnaturally into the background blur and the rabbit behind it (fusion artifact), and slight haloing is visible on the ear edges of the rightmost rabbit. The pose auditor flagged medium risk for rabbit anatomy (35% low-confidence keypoints), particularly in hind limbs and face, suggesting potential anatomical ambiguity despite the realistic appearance. These defects prevent a perfect authenticity score.
key_defects: Spatial inversion: Rabbits are rendered in front of the giraffe instead of behind it.
Structural fusion at giraffe neck base blending into background/rabbit.
Anatomical uncertainty in rabbit hind limbs and ears (pose auditor MEDIUM risk).
